messages:
sophia: Postmortem follow-up: we captured multiple remediation items around GPU headroom, autoscale, and quota. Need a single-line owner + ETA + one-line rollback we can execute from the oncall console. I'll import to the action tracker by EOD.

mike: I'll own scheduler experiments & canary plan. Scope: fairness weight sweep, preempt tuning, and small-batch enforcement. Canary plan: feature-flagged 10% traffic for 48h, metric gates on p99 and error-rate. ETA: 9 business days for full proposal (draft next Tue). Rollback: flip feature flag OFF and revert scheduler config to last stable commit.

raj: I'll take vendor quota path and sales-assisted reserved pool. Filing vendor support + internal ticket. ETA: 2 business days to file initial request. Rollback: enable reserved burst pool and trigger Sales uplift flow; route high-throughput tenants to alternate region if needed.

_tess: I'll add a lightweight staging canary harness and an automated perf baseline. Also adding a p99 alert and a canary vs baseline dashboard. ETA: 3 days. Rollback: mute canary split, revert routing, run quick smoke A/B.

nate: I'll author an emergency headroom playbook (concise runbook with console steps) and propose a short surge-night rota for ops. ETA: 5 days. Rollback: exact console CLI to reduce max_instances and enable low-priority throttles (will include commands).

emily: I'll instrument per-tenant queue/backlog and token burn metrics so we can detect tenant-driven surges and trigger predictive scaling earlier. ETA: 7 days. Rollback: none runtime, but will add alert gating notes.

ops-bot: Ticket created: INF-6007 \u2014 "Autoscale + quota follow-ups: vendor request & scheduler canary" (assignee: raj). https://tracker.redwood.ai/INF-6007

mike: Canary details (short): start internal 10% traffic for 24h -> if stable, expand to 10% external for 48h. Gate: p99 change < 10% and error-rate delta < 0.5% else rollback. Will include feature-flag rollout steps and canary dashboard.

tess: Proposed PromQL for p99 alert (draft):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, tenant))
```
Alert: p99 > 450ms for 10m -> page oncall and mute canary routing.

raj: Vendor path: open support + quota form. If approval delayed > 48h -> Sales to enable reserved pool for short window and notify affected customers. Adding checklist for emergency activation.

emily: Instrumentation plan: per-tenant backlog + last-5m token burn rate, plus a rolling 1h surge score. Will add synthetic traffic jobs to validate detection.

nate: Headroom play (high level): 1) shift non-critical tenants to quantized variants; 2) increase autoscale max_instances (if quota); 3) pre-warm reserved pool for 30m; 4) if saturated -> enable reserved capacity via Sales + apply throttles on low-priority lanes. PR to infra/runbooks will include exact console paths.

sophia: TL;DR for tracker (owners, ETA, ticket): scheduler=mike (9bd), quota=raj (2bd, INF-6007), canary+alert=tess (3d), runbook=nate (5d), telemetry=emily (7d). Please paste the 1-line rollback you want SRE to run.

mike: rollback: flip sched_v2 OFF, revert scheduler commit, set max_batch_size=8.

raj: rollback: enable reserved burst pool + request emergency uplift through Sales; failover tenants to alternate region if vendor blocks.

tess: rollback: mute canary routing and revert traffic split; run quick smoke to validate baseline.

emily: instrumentation is read-only; will include detection mute if noisy.

nate: adding console commands for rollback in PR; will post link here once ready.

sophia: Thanks all  I'll import these into the remediation tracker and schedule a 20-min sync early next week to review progress. Please post short updates in this thread as you make changes so the tracker shows live status. :calendar:

ops-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Capacity tactical checklist handoff" Mon 10:00  attendees: sophia, mike, raj, tess, nate, emily

mike: ack
